profile.headline: Building Websites as Strategic as They Are Accessible for Women-Owned Businesses | Software Engineer & Accessibility Engineer | Founder of soffyn | Developed By Akia LLC
profile.summary:
Your website is costing you money whether it's working or not. And if someone tries to find you online and lands on something that doesn't come close to showing what you actually do, or worse, can't use it at all, that cost just got higher.

I'm Akia. Software engineer, accessibility engineer, and creative. I build high-converting websites for small business owners who are ready for a web presence that finally matches the business they've built.

A gorgeous site can still cost you customers. Bad flow, broken mobile experience, accessibility dead ends — they all add up. Beauty matters. It just can't be the only thing. I build for both.

Before I write a single line of code, I sit with you and figure out what your site actually needs to do, who's landing on it, what they need to feel, and what needs to happen for them to say yes. That part isn't extra. It's the whole point. It's also the part most developers skip, and it's why so many beautiful sites don't convert.

Accessibility is very important to me. I've spent my career watching people get quietly excluded by design that never considered them, customers who couldn't navigate a checkout, visitors who couldn't read the text, users who were just left behind because nobody thought about them when the site was built. I think about them every time. Beautiful, fast, and built so that every single person who lands on it can actually use it. 

Not most people. Everyone.

I'm also building soffyn, a wellness app designed specifically for Black women, launching Q4 2026. I'm neurodivergent myself, and I got tired of watching people who think and feel differently get handed tools that were never made for them. 

Both businesses came from the same belief: that the people who've been overlooked by design deserve better.

If you're ready for a website that works as hard as you do, let’s build!

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Great web experiences shouldn’t be a luxury and they shouldn’t leave people behind. Through Developed By Akia LLC I work with women-owned businesses to build websites that are as inclusive as they are beautiful.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · SEO Copywriting · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Flexible Approach · Conflict Management

positions.title: ServiceNow NextGen Graduate
positions.description:
The ServiceNow NextGen Professionals Reskill program is a 12-week program which provides ServiceNow instructor-led training, self-paced Now Learning content, practical exercises, and hands-on project work. Coupled with career readiness skills and real-world examples, the ServiceNow NextGen Professionals program allows every person no matter their experience to smoothly transition into the ServiceNow workforce. 

•	Configured and administered workflows collaboratively to support various processes.
•	Gained knowledge around customizable support solutions on the ServiceNow platform related to ITSM, Service Portal, Scripting, and Change Management.
•	Participated in knowledge-sharing and collaboration sprints, contributing to the overall improvement of team productivity.
•	Implemented ServiceNow customization and development including Scripting, Service Portal creation, IT Service Management, and IT Service Management Implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Instructional Designer - Retail Learning and Development Team
positions.description:
• 	Designed and developed interactive e-learning courses for retail employees using authoring tools such as Adobe Captivate.
• 	Collaborated with subject matter experts to identify learning objectives and create effective training materials that met business needs and compliance requirements.
• 	Created visually appealing mobile responsive user-friendly interfaces for e-learning courses using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• 	Conducted user testing and quality assurance to ensure that e-learning courses were error-free and met accessibility standards.
• 	Increased employee engagement with training materials, overall usage and completion to over 51%, exceeding the company’s target goal.

positions.title: Genius Bar Technician (Mac & Mobile Device IT Support)
positions.description:
• 	Offered friendly, hands-on technical assistance to 300+ customers monthly, troubleshooting and diagnosing iOS/MacOS hardware and software issues.
• 	Provided compassionate, on-the-spot product issue diagnosis and explanation.
•      Maintained an average customer service rating of 80% or higher in a fast-paced environment.

positions.title: Applecare Advisor(Mac and iPhone Software Support)
positions.description:
•	Delivered comprehensive, software-based problem-solving via chat, email, or phone to remote customers, adhering to company standards and technology.
•	Swiftly diagnosed product issues and arrived at effective solutions, resulting in a 25% reduction in average call/chat handling times.
•	Consistently met or exceeded individual key performance indicators, including customer satisfaction ratings, issue resolution rates, and productivity targets.

positions.title: Code Camp Instructor
positions.description:
Coding Fundamentals and Programming Robots — Worked with children ages 8–12 exploring fun activities to learn how to code Sphero robots, using Swift. Exposing children to coding fundamentals like commands, loops, and functions, then use blocks of code to create a program using the Sphero Edu app for iPad

•	Led a Swift-based Sphero robot coding program for 20 children, teaching coding fundamentals via technology and storyboards.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the design team to create and implement responsive web designs and user interfaces for the company's rental platform.
• Built reusable UI components using React and AngularJS, resulting in increased development efficiency and reduced maintenance costs.
• Implemented cross-browser compatibility fixes and optimized site performance using tools like Chrome Developer Tools and PageSpeed Insights.
• Worked with the back-end development team to integrate APIs and data sources into the platform.
• Conducted user testing and gathered feedback to improve site usability and overall user experience.

positions.title: Technical Assistant
positions.description:
Led an after-school program of intercity girls, in grade range from 6-8th, teaching them fundamentals of JavaScript and Python
web development, as well as mobile application development. 
•	Led 15 girls in developing an Ice Breaker Quiz App using JavaScript and Python, testing on an Android Emulator.
•	Led one-hour Scratch workshop on "Imagine a World" theme, teaching JavaScript fundamentals such as while and for loops.
•	Inspired creativity by using varied images and drawing unique sprites/backgrounds to bring children's ideas to life.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Python (Programming Language) · HTML · Project Management · Team Building · Flexible Approach · Conflict Management

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained websites & web apps using HTML, CSS, JS & MySQL.
•	Managed website content using WebFlow & other CMS.
•	Collaborated with stakeholders to develop and implement new features and functionality.
•	Utilized Git for code changes and collaboration.
•	Tracked website performance using Google Analytics, resulting in a 15% increase in website traffic and 10% in listening and conversion rates worldwide.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Flexible Approach · Conflict Management · Entrepreneurship

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
Rigorous 4-month technology training and leadership program offering: 1000+ hours of immersive, hands-on, project-based earning in a fast-paced agile environment.
•	Collaborated in a team to create a functional app addressing a client's business problem, serving as designer, analyst, developer and quality analyst. Worked with team to develop and present a proposal to client's RFP.
•	Facilitated flow of information between client and team as business analyst, updating team on client expectations.
•	Wrote user stories and used acceptance test-driven development to confirm the completion of a story.
•	Created branding assets for employee engagement application.
•	Created components of application solution as developer using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js server, Git, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Customer Care Representative
positions.description:
•	Provided exceptional service, managing post-paid accounts, handling billing inquiries, and delivering seamless experiences to Verizon Wireless customers.
•	Streamlined device upgrade processes for cellular and smart devices through efficient account management, delivering seamless experiences for customers.
•	Resolved Tier 1 device troubleshooting issues promptly and effectively for basic, smartphone, and connected devices.
•	Built strong customer relationships, enhancing their overall experience through rapport building and exceptional service.
